name: MMRo
description: MMRo is the first benchmark for evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) as the cognitive core for robotic systems. It tests four essential capabilities: perception, task planning, visual reasoning, and safety measurement, across multiple scenarios with 14 evaluation metrics.
reputation: A recent benchmark introduced for assessing MLLMs in robotics, with growing interest but still limited long-term community adoption.
notes: Includes evaluation of commercial and open-source MLLMs; data available at https://mm-robobench.github.io/.
